contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: A question about your order, hair advice or a partnership? Write to us — we reply within 24–48h.
contact.hours: Available 6 days a week — reply within 24 to 48 business hours.
contact.withdrawalHint: To exercise your 14-day right of withdrawal, use the online form: you will receive an acknowledgement of receipt by email. You can also write below if you have a question about a refund in progress.
contact.success: Your email client will open with the message ready to send.
